title: [crm] Incorrect crm counter for ipv4(6)_next_hop
author: bingwang-ms

**Description**
The crm counter for ipv4_next_hop and ipv6_next_hop is incorrect, which leads to test failure in test_crm.
<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Set crm polling interval to 1 second ```crm config polling interval 1```.
 The default polling interval is 300 seconds. This setting is to reduce waiting time between set and check. 
2. Retrieve used and available nexthop count
```
root@str-dx010-acs-4:~# redis-cli --raw -n 2 HMGET CRM:STATS crm_stats_ipv4_nexthop_used crm_stats_ipv4_nexthop_available
4
32691
```
3. Add a permanent nexthop
```
root@str-dx010-acs-4:~# ip neigh replace 2.2.2.2 lladdr 11:22:33:44:55:66 dev PortChannel0001
``` 
4. Retrieve new value of used and available nexthop count after several seconds.
```
root@str-dx010-acs-4:~# redis-cli --raw -n 2 HMGET CRM:STATS crm_stats_ipv4_nexthop_used crm_stats_ipv4_nexthop_available
5
32689
```
The used count is increased by 1, while the available count is decreased by 2
5. Delete the nexthop set in step 3
```
ip neigh del 2.2.2.2 lladdr 11:22:33:44:55:66 dev PortChannel0001
```
6. Retrieve new value of used and available nexthop count after deleting nexthop after several seconds.
```
root@str-dx010-acs-4:~# redis-cli --raw -n 2 HMGET CRM:STATS crm_stats_ipv4_nexthop_used crm_stats_ipv4_nexthop_available
4
32690
```
The used count of nexthop is restored to 4. However, the available count is not recoverd. This issue also exists for ipv6_nexthop.

**Describe the results you received:**
The available count of nexthop is not recoverd after deleting manually added nexthop. 

**Describe the results you expected:**
The available count of nexthop is exactly same after deleting manually added nexthop with that before adding the nexthop.

comments.author: gechiang
comments.body:
This looks to be new issue introduced by SAI 4.2.1.3
I rolled back to previous version (3.7.5.1) and it was working fine.
On the very first version of master image using SAI 4.2.1.3 this issue is observed.
Tried on two different BRCM DUTs  one on Celestica-DX010-C32 (BCM56960_B1 ) and another one on Force10-S6000 (BCM56850_A2).  Both shows the same failing behavior.
From the code this available resource counter is read from SAI via sai_switch_api->get_switch_attribute with attribute "SAI_SWITCH_ATTR_AVAILABLE_IPV4_NEXTHOP_ENTRY" (IPV4 case) and somehow this number is being decremented by 2 instead of by 1 when a new nexthop is used.  When the nexthop is not used, this resource counter got restored back by 1 only.
Have opened a new BRCM case (CS00011396506) requesting BRCM to investigate/address this issue.

linkedPullRequests.title: Moving BRCM SAI 4.2.1.3 to 4.2.1.3-1 to pick up fix for CS00011396506…
linkedPullRequests.author: gechiang
linkedPullRequests.body:
… to fix CRM nexthop resource in-use leak

**- Why I did it**
SAI 4.2.1.3 has a CRM resource leak issue with nexthop resource for both IPV4 and IPV6.  A patch to address this issue was provided by BRCM and validated with a private build.  merging this fix to master branch.

**- How to verify it**
For details about CRM issue please refer to (https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/5583).
Repeated the test procedure and validated that the leak is no longer observed with SAI 4.2.1.3-1

**- Which release branch to backport (provide reason below if selected)**

- [ ] 201811
- [ ] 201911
- [x] 202006

Only if 202006 is also SAI4.2.1 based.

**- Description for the changelog**
Moving BRCM SAI 4.2.1.3 to 4.2.1.3-1 to pick up fix for CS00011396506 to fix CRM nexthop (IPV4/IPV6) resource in-use leak

Fixes #5583
